issue_request: FHIR-11057 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 Consent and requested removing/renaming Consent.recipient in favor of Consent.actor because the controlled actor was not limited to a recipient.
initial_application: Commit 612068c158 applied the STU3 Consent updates for GF#11053 and GF#11057, changing spreadsheet-era source from Consent.recipient and a recipient search parameter to !Consent.recipient plus Consent.actor, Consent.actor.role, and Consent.actor.reference.
additional_context: Consent is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source has Consent.grantee and Consent.provision.actor and no Consent.recipient element/path. FHIR-31906 later converted Consent.performer to Consent.grantor and Consent.grantee while retaining provision actors for computable consent, so the absence of a top-level Consent.actor is a later model decision rather than an incomplete FHIR-11057 application. FHIR-10691 separately approved general recipient(s) wording in the Consent definition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit; no source edit was made because current source already satisfies the removal of Consent.recipient.
